name: blender-in-remotion
description: Blender renders as elements of a Remotion video: a Remotion scene on a 3D laptop, and a transparent character in a flat scene

scripts.screen: npx remotion render src/index.ts Screen out/screen.mp4 --crf=8
scripts.blender: npm run screen && npm run blender:room && npm run blender:desk
scripts.render: npx remotion render src/index.ts BlenderInRemotion out/blender-in-remotion.mp4
scripts.render:preview: npx remotion render src/index.ts BlenderInRemotion out/preview.mp4 --scale=0.5
